title: Molecular docking and in vivo/in vitro studies of a novel thiadiazole Schiff base as a hepatoprotective drug against angiogenesis induced by breast cancer
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39027-39039
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06398H, Paper

Norah F. Alqahtani, Mohammad Y. Alfaifi, Ali Shati A, Serag Eldin I. Elbehairi, Abdulrahman M. Saleh, Ebtesam S. Kotb, Waleed M. Serag, Reda F. M. Elshaarawy, Heba W. Alhamdi, Yasser A. Hassan
Two new thiadiazole imidazolium salicylidene Schiff bases (TISSBs) were successfully synthesized, and their structures were analyzed comprehensively using spectroscopic techniques.
